metadata.description: phot-o-MATIC — on-device footage triage for photographers. The marketplace manifest lives at the repository root and the pack lives in ./phot-o-matic, the same shape as the other o-MATIC doors.

plugins.name: phot-o-matic
plugins.description: phot-o-MATIC decodes video on Apple silicon and finds the frames worth a second look: a whole-frame luminance-rise detector paired with an on-device Vision classifier. Every candidate carries its frame index, timecode, the rise over a local median baseline, 10-bit Y-plane statistics, classifier confidences, and a written thumbnail. The classification runs on the machine, so looking at several thousand frames costs no tokens.

metadata.compatibilityTier: MCP-host-full-operation ONLY, AND macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon (arm64) ONLY — this plugin ships a native Mach-O binary, not a script
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: a host able to launch stdio MCP servers, running macOS 26+ on arm64. There is no Intel build and no non-Apple port: the engine links Vision, CoreML and AVFoundation directly, which is the whole reason the classification runs on-device and costs no tokens.
metadata.note: THIS PHASE SHIPS THE ENGINE AND NO JUDGMENT. The coaching verdict is rendered from a criteria set, and no criteria set is bundled here. Until one is, every scan returns coaching.available=false together with the reason and the paths searched — unless the host has a criteria set of its own installed, in which case that one is loaded and said so. Read the field rather than inferring a verdict. Hosts below the macOS/arch floor get a server advertising zero tools and stating the reason, rather than a silent failure that reads as 'not configured yet'. The six MCP tool names are still walk_* : Walk was the development name, the tool names are the stable API, and they deliberately did not move when the product was named.
